saints.name: St. Joseph of Cupertino
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: The simple Franciscan friar whose ecstasies at prayer were said to lift him bodily from the ground…
biography: Born in 1603 in a stable at Cupertino in southern Italy, Joseph was a slow and awkward youth, refused by several communities before he was received among the Conventual Franciscans. Ordained a priest, he became so absorbed in prayer that he fell frequently into ecstasies, during which, according to a great many witnesses, he was seen to rise into the air.

These wonders drew crowds, and his superiors, wary of the excitement, moved him from house to house and kept him in seclusion for years, which he bore with humble obedience. He died in 1663 and was canonized in 1767; he is honoured as patron of students and, in modern times, of aviators.
saints.knownFor: His profound ecstasies at prayer and his childlike humility.
